newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CHELSEA REACH F.A. CUP FINAL WITH 3-0 WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHELSEA REACH F.A. CUP FINAL WITH 3-0 WIN.

text.p: Chelsea reached the English Football Association (F.A.) Cup final for the second time in four seasons as goals from Mark Hughes and Gianfranco Zola gave them a deserved 3-0 win over Wimbledon in a keenly-fought semifinal at Highbury on Sunday.
Chelsea should know their opponents in the Wembley final on May 17 later on Sunday after Middlesbrough and Chesterfield meet in the second semifinal at Old Trafford.

Hughes, who played against Chelsea for Manchester United in the London side's last Cup Final appearance in 1994, put Ruud Gullit's team on the way to victory when he scored from close range after 42 minutes after Wimbledon failed to clear a Dennis Wise cross.
Zola added the second in the 64th minute when he outpaced the Wimbledon defence and rifled home an unstoppable right-foot drive which gave goalkeeper Neil Sullivan no chance.
In the final minute Hughes made it 3-0 when he picked up the ball outside the box and calmly slotted it home.
Chelsea have previously reached the final in 1915, 1967, 1970 and 1994 with their only victory coming when they beat Leeds in a replay in 1970.
